ios.desc:
Meet. Share. Remember.

IntroKeep is the calm, private way to turn a brief introduction into a relationship worth remembering.

Create one professional identity and share it in seconds. Scan a paper card or import contacts without retyping. Keep the place, event, and reason you met alongside every saved connection, so your library stays useful long after the handshake.

Built for trust:
- Share only what you choose
- Review uncertain card details before saving
- Keep scanned contacts private unless they claim their profile
- Resolve duplicates safely and preserve source context
- Export or delete your data when you choose
- Set reminders for the follow-ups that matter
- Let visitors share a name and one contact method back without creating an account
- See optional privacy-safe card scan counts without storing IP addresses or device fingerprints
- Use one profile photo across your account and cards that follow your profile default

IntroKeep is for independent professionals, event participants, sales teams, and anyone replacing paper cards with a more thoughtful way to stay in touch.
